system.description:
Axe | Long Axe [great range]

Base form: you can use the weapon to strike a quick and accurate blow. Cost: 1 Stamina.

Alternate form: you can use the weapon to strike a powerful blow, with increased Effect. Cost: 2 Stamina.

+ Imbrued with blood: you soak the blade in your own blood. Gain +1d to the roll per each Blood you mark.
